verdict.rationale: First-party docs cover all three named formats. The FBX import pipeline handles meshes, animations, materials and textures, a dedicated page covers glTF import and export, and another covers USD import and editing. USD is flagged as a Beta feature, and nothing in the pack shows that imports are actually 'clean'. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent corroboration of import fidelity, USD out of Beta, and glTF/USD docs detailing which asset types (animation, materials) round-trip.
